item.headline: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees, Says He Is in Therapy
item.summary: A day after returning to his company, Mr. Huang acknowledged that he violated Nvidia’s code of conduct and that he “made some terrible mistakes.”
item.author: Tripp Mickle and Kalley Huang

reads.result: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang, a day after returning to the company, apologised to employees, admitted he broke Nvidia’s code of conduct and made terrible mistakes, and said he is in therapy.
